status: Retrospective diagnostic protocol recorded after independent review; historical test already known. Not external preregistration.
target: Next-calendar-day increment of coordinate-derived reference-relative displacement norm, in mm; zero increment is the baseline. Add current observed norm only to reconstruct a level for presentation.

variant_definitions.lag2: Expanded train-only tuning, same four input channels and conservative two-date rainfall availability as previous main evaluation.
variant_definitions.no_rain: Matched selected architecture, stopping epoch and seeds, remove rain input; no variant-specific tuning.
variant_definitions.lag1: One-date rainfall lag, optimistic availability sensitivity because sensor/BOM timestamp alignment is unconfirmed. Not a proven deployable information set.
variant_definitions.increment_only: Remove absolute displacement-level input; retain previous increments, reading intervals and lag-two rain. Tests dependence on reference-relative level input.

selection: Choose 24 architecture/learning-rate/dropout candidates using three training-only temporal folds. Early stopping monitors increment MAE (normalisation is train-only). Refit for the median best epoch across those folds. All variants use this choice, five seeds and identical common source keys. Do not tune on test or promote a favourable variant to a new confirmatory primary result.
inference: Four sensitivity-versus-zero-increment contrasts, shared segmented temporal resampling, ordinary and four-contrast Bonferroni intervals. Exploratory conditional on fixed models and observed date gaps; original main comparison retained separately.
